Type: round mesh wall shelf unit
Use: displaying plants, jars and decor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: farmhouse, rustic, industrial
Materials: chicken wire mesh, galvanized iron straps, natural wood shelves
Colors: grey galvanized metal, warm brown wood
Shape: large circle with crisscross metal bands, three wooden shelves behind wire mesh, textured, medium visual weight
Feel: rustic, homey, textured
Goes with: white shiplap, light wood, greenery, neutral textiles; farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Round Metal Mesh Hanging Wall Shelf Unit with 3 Shelves - 30 Inch, Natural Wood and Galvanized Iron
product.description: Display your books or tchotchkes on this circular 3-tiered shelving unit. Round iron mesh surrounds the three fir shelves for a slight nautical look, and iron bands in the back add boldness to the design. 30.12"H x 30.12"W x 6.1"D 80% iron; 20% fir Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
